name: qa-intake
description: Normalize a new ticket, identify acceptance criteria and missing requirements, and establish traceable source references.

name: qa-planner
description: Review ticket requirements, Figma, and documentation; assess risk and write the test plan.

name: qa-cases
description: Create detailed manual and automation candidate test cases with requirement traceability.

name: qa-automation
description: Implement and maintain TypeScript Playwright tests for reviewed ticket cases.

name: qa-execution
description: Run Playwright tests, guide manual execution, and record actual results and evidence.

name: qa-defects
description: Triage observed failures, draft reproducible defect reports, and track fix verification.

name: qa-release
description: Independently evaluate ticket release readiness against coverage, current build results, and defect retests.

name: qa-automation-reviewer
description: After ticket completion, assess generated Playwright for promotion, adapt qualified tests to the main suite's existing POM and fixtures, and validate the reviewable result.

name: qa-knowledge
description: Curate verified reusable product knowledge, regression lessons, and durable handoffs shared across tools.
